items.title: 8.4 Policies, qawaneen aur zimmedarana jiddat (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of policies, regulations and responsible innovation (PDF 117-118).

blocks.text: Jaise jaise ubharti technologies aage barhti hain, unhein mehfooz aur akhlaqi rakhne ke liye wazeh policies aur zimmedarana jiddat zaroori hai (Fig 8.7). Qawaneen, hukmrani ke dhaanche aur shobon ke darmiyan ishtirak taraqqi aur jawabdehi ka tawazun rakhte hain, aur inhein samajhna talaba ko munsifana, shamooliyat wale aur muashre ke liye mufeed hal design karne mein madad deta hai.

blocks.title: Kya aap jante hain?
blocks.text: AI, IoT, cloud aur blockchain ko milana rozmarra zindagi ke liye zyada zaheen aur kaar-amad systems bana sakta hai.

AI, IoT aur blockchain raazdari, rozgar, faisla sazi aur hifazat par asar dalti hain. Munasib qawaneen ke baghair in ka ghalat istemal ho sakta ya ghair-munsifana nataij aa sakte hain, is liye policies tay karti hain ke data kaise jama, mehfooz aur use ho, logon ko mehfooz aur un ke huqooq bachate hue. Aalmi satah par GDPR data ki hifazat aur raazdari ke miyar muqarrar karta, aur bain-ul-aqwami AI akhlaqi usool khud-kaar faislon mein shaffafiyat aur insaf ko farogh dete hain. Mulk apni AI hikmat-e-amali bana rahe hain; Pakistan ke liye aise dhaanche apnana technology ki taraqqi ko akhlaqi miyar aur shehriyon ke mafadat ke mutabiq rakhta hai.

Zimmedarana jiddat sirf maali faide ke bajaye insani bhalai ko aage rakhti hai. Technology ko zindagi ka miyar behtar, mauqe paida aur nuqsan kam karna chahiye, aur developers ko taveel samaji aur mahoolyati asraat dekhne chahiye taake fawaid biradariyon tak munsifana pohanchein.

blocks.title: Dilchasp baat
blocks.text: Behtareen technologies logon ko pehle rakhti hain; akhlaqiyat aur hamdardi jiddat ke kaleedi ajza hain.

Zimmedarana, munsifana technology ko bohat se shobon ke maahireen chahiye: qanooni maahireen yaqeeni banate ke systems qanoon ki pabandi karein, samajiyat ke maahireen un ka samaji asar parhte, aur akhlaqiyat ke maahireen akhlaqi faislon ki rehnumai karte hain. Hal un logon ke tanawwo ki akkasi bhi karein jin ki woh khidmat karte hain: zaban, saqafat aur rasai ke farq dekh kar developers aise systems banate hain jo sirf aik group nahi, sab ke liye chalein.

blocks.alt: Ek doosre ke andar daire: bain-ul-aqwami dhaanche (bahar), qaumi policy, developers, aur darmiyan log. Saath 'working together' dabba: qanooni maahireen (qanoon ki pabandi), samajiyat ke maahireen (samaji asar), akhlaqiyat ke maahireen (akhlaqi faisle), engineers (mehfooz, chalte systems) aur users aur biradariyan (zarooratein, zabanein, rasai). Note: logon ko pehle rakhein; technology sirf munafe nahi, zindagiyan munsifana behtar kare.
blocks.caption: Hukmrani ki tahein aur kai shobon ki team (Fig 8.7 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Qawaid aik saath kai satahon se aate hain, aur un ke andar banane ke liye aik se zyada shobon ke log chahiye.

blocks.prompt: Hospital ke AI project ko programmers ke saath qanooni maahir aur akhlaqiyat ka maahir kyun chahiye?
blocks.explanation: Qanooni maahir yaqeeni banata hai ke mareezon ka data data-protection qanoon aur ijazat ke saath jama aur mehfooz ho; akhlaqiyat ka maahir dekhta hai ke system tamam mareezon se munsifana sulook kare, us ke faisle samjhaye ja sakein, aur ghalti par kaun zimmedar ho. Akele programmers durusti par tawajjuh de kar yeh khatre nazar-andaz kar sakte hain.

items: Policies aur qawaneen (GDPR, AI akhlaqi usool, qaumi AI hikmat-e-amali) mehfooz, munsifana istemal ki rehnumai.
Zimmedarana jiddat insani bhalai aur taveel asar ko pehle rakhti.
Kai shobon ki teams (qanoon, samajiyat, akhlaqiyat, engineering) technology ko shamooliyat wala banati.
